caption:
"Write it down and let it go" sounds right until you try it. You write it down. Your brain keeps going. Because writing something down doesn't give it an ending — it just gives it a second location. The Landing gives the thought somewhere to land. We're building a guided journal for overthinkers — DM "JOURNAL" for a free sample. Save this for tonight.

#journaling #overthinking #anxiety #mentalhealth #arajournals
